title: Is a node object or an array of them
description: The root of a JSON-LD 1.1 document must take the form of a single node object, or an array whose members are node objects.
$comment: Tier 0. The root shape a JSON-LD 1.1 document may take, which is the part of the grammar a schema can carry without seeing the active context. It overlaps tro-minimal, which requires an object root for a TRO specifically; the overlap is deliberate. items applies only to arrays, so it gates itself and no if/then is needed.

errorMessage.type: every member of a JSON-LD document written as an array is a node object
a JSON-LD document is a node object, or an array of node objects
